routes.route_name: The Iron Line Express (Main Railway Spur)
routes.primary_cargo_manifest: 7.62x54mm reloaded ammunition, diesel fuel drums, machined boiler fittings, refined coal briquettes
routes.caravan_master_log: Armored draisine tractor running on rail track. Easy navigation, but watch for loosened fishplates and magnetic track mines placed by canal bandits.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Salted river carp, cured otter pelts, distilled turnip ethanol, copper drainage pipes
routes.caravan_master_log: Flat-bottom pole barges. Quiet travel, but heavy radioactive silt at the reedbed. Pay Baroness Rada's toll promptly or her snipers will drill your hull.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Hard winter rye grain sacks, fermented silage molasses, dried turnip flour, seed potatoes
routes.caravan_master_log: Draft horses pulling heavy sleds across the frozen loess. Straightforward route, but keep horse gas hoods fitted if the wind shifts from the east.

routes.route_name: The St. Nicholas Pilgrimage & Mercy Trek
routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Pure artesian spring water carboys, herbal wound salves, tallow funeral tapers, dried mountain thyme
routes.caravan_master_log: Pack mules led by Sisterhood novitiates. Recognized sanctuary flags respected by 95% of wasteland raiders. Very low combat risk.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Anthracite lump coal, foundry coke, cast iron furnace grates, crude battery sulfuric acid
routes.caravan_master_log: Armored steam tractors hauling heavy iron ore carts. Slow speed (8 km/h) makes it vulnerable to pack ambushes from steppe wolves in Red Ash Gulch.

routes.route_name: The Steam Valley Mineral Salt Pass
routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Thermal sulfur bath salts, medicinal mud packs, refined cinnabar mercury, hot spring bath chits
routes.caravan_master_log: Thick sulfur fog reduces visibility to ten meters. Watch your step around geyser vents; one wrong turn will melt your rubber boots into molten slag.

routes.route_name: The An-22 Peat Bog Salvage Run
routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Duralumin sheet metal, titanium hydraulic struts, avionics copper wire, pre-war aircraft tires
routes.caravan_master_log: Difficult terrain across quaking frozen peat. High radiation (0.35 mR/h) along the entire route. Dosimeter checks required every two hours.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Recharged lead-acid storage batteries, copper busbars, porcelain insulators, electrical switches
routes.caravan_master_log: Engineers driving electric crawler carts recharged from overhead wires along the high-tension easement. Smooth, quiet, and highly reliable.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Tire snowshoes, cured wolf pelts, reconditioned spark plugs, mobile forge repair tools
routes.caravan_master_log: Tracked tractors carving new paths through snowdrifts. Route shifts weekly to avoid radioactive fallout plumes. Nomad scouts ride point with carbines.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Bartered goods, refined salt, silver scrap coins, printed regional gazettes, sewing needles
routes.caravan_master_log: Paved pre-war asphalt highway. Heavy merchant traffic protected by joint treaty guards. The safest commercial artery in Tessarat.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Dressed granite armor blocks, crushed ballast gravel, refractory quartzite sand, steel wedges
routes.caravan_master_log: Massive four-wheeled timber wagons loaded with 10 tons of quarried granite. Slow descents require heavy hand-crank brakes on steep switchbacks.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Handwritten barometric synoptic charts, telescope sighting logs, dried mountain moss, alpine ice blocks
routes.caravan_master_log: Foot courier on crampons and rope teams. Sudden blizzards and sub-zero gales can drop visibility to zero in minutes. High freezing risk.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Pre-war copper pipe fittings, ceramic tiles, track iron stakes, dried subterranean mushrooms
routes.caravan_master_log: Hand-pumped railway draisines through dry subway tunnel tubes. 100% weather-proof and zero radiation exposure. Occasional pack rat swarms.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Certified heirloom seed packets, fresh lemons, raw greenhouse honey, live fruit tree scions
routes.caravan_master_log: Heated insulated handcarts protecting delicate citrus trees and honey jars from frost. Elena's agronomists personally escort every delivery.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Liquid roofing pitch drums, waterproofing asphalt tar, creosote wood preservative, lamp oil
routes.caravan_master_log: Two-wheeled ox carts carrying hot insulated pitch kettles. Smells strongly of asphalt and sulfur. Essential for waterproofing canal barges and roofs.

routes.route_name: The Iron Crane Ghost Zone Expedition
routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Heavy crane steel cables, bulldozer track shoes, high-tensile winch drums, lead ballast blocks
routes.caravan_master_log: Extreme hazard (1.8 R/h). Only seasoned scouts in lead-apron hazmat suits with potassium iodide regimens. Two-headed steppe wolves stalk caravan tracks.

routes.route_name: The Copper Wire Post Dispatch Line
routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Sealed courier mail pouches, telegraph punch tape reels, dried batteries, postal chit stamps
routes.caravan_master_log: Fast ski and bicycle couriers running along the telegraph pole line. Quickest communication artery linking eastern valley settlements with border bridges.

routes.primary_cargo_manifest: Compressed brewer's yeast cakes, dark bock beer kegs, liquid malt syrup, copper boiling kettles
routes.caravan_master_log: Celebratory monthly caravan welcomed with cheers across all valley sectors. Supplies Cook Oxana with vital vitamin B yeast cakes and morale beer.
